en.headline: Observatory issues Strong Monsoon Signal for easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the signal at 4.45am on Wednesday, warning of mean winds exceeding 40 km/h from the east with occasional gale-force gusts.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Strong Monsoon Signal at 4.45am on Wednesday, stating that strong winds with a mean speed exceeding 40 kilometres per hour are expected from the east, with gusts occasionally reaching gale force.
The Observatory advised people not well sheltered from the east to take precautions against strong gusty winds, including taking flower pots and other objects likely to be blown away indoors.

Those planning water sports activities or operations at sea were told to take special care against high winds and rough sea conditions, which are particularly rough over the offshore waters. The signal remains in force until further notice.

zh.headline: 天文台發出強烈季候風信號 預料吹偏東強風
zh.dek: 天文台周三凌晨四時四十五分發出信號，預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速每小時超過四十公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
body: 香港天文台周三凌晨四時四十五分發出強烈季候風信號，表示預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速每小時超過四十公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
天文台提醒，若身在當風地方，會受到偏東風正面吹襲，應採取預防措施，以防強勁陣風帶來損害，花盆及可能被風吹倒的物件應搬入室內。
打算參加水上運動或進行海上工作的人士請特別小心，以防大風大浪帶來的危險，離岸海域風浪尤其大。信號現正生效，直至另行通知。
